description: A wrapper for the standard Text component that allows animation of style properties using the Animated API.
usage: Use Animated.Value or Animated.ValueXY to animate properties such as opacity, color, position, scale, or rotation of text.

methods.timing: Animate a value over a specified duration with easing.
methods.spring: Animate a value using spring physics.
methods.decay: Animate a value with initial velocity, gradually slowing to stop.
methods.add/subtract/multiply/divide/modulo: Combine animated values for complex animations.
methods.interpolate: Map input ranges of an Animated.Value to output ranges (e.g., colors, sizes, positions).
methods.sequence: Run multiple animations one after another.
methods.parallel: Run multiple animations at the same time.
methods.loop: Repeat an animation multiple times or infinitely.

notes: Always use useNativeDriver: true where possible for better performance.
Animated.Text can animate style properties only, not text content directly.
For color changes, use interpolate with an Animated.Value mapped to color strings.
